description: This file provides declarations and interfaces for a command line interface (CLI) server and client within a software project. It includes function prototypes for server initialization, socket activity processing, command execution, and client command execution, as well as external variable declarations related to CLI operation.

methods.name: CLI_SERVER_UpdateSocketSet
methods.description: Updates the socket set to monitor for activity.

methods.name: CLI_SERVER_ProcessSocketActivity
methods.description: Processes socket activity for the CLI server.

methods.name: CLI_SERVER_SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response string to the CLI client.

methods.name: CLI_SERVER_IsCmdRunLocally
methods.description: Checks if a command should be run locally.

methods.name: CLI_CLIENT_ExecCommand
methods.description: Executes a CLI command from the client side.
